mLocKeys.keySummary: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Rakan dashes to an allied champion, granting them @TotalShield@ Shield for @Duration@ seconds.

Rakan can Recast this Ability once within @RecastWindow@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Cast range is increased when cast on Xayah.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Tumble</titleLeft><mainText>Vayne deals increased damage with her next basic attack.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Battle Dance</titleLeft><mainText>Rakan may cast Battle Dance again at no cost.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Battle Dance</titleLeft><mainText>Rakan has granted this unit a shield.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Every @ShieldCooldown@ seconds, Rakan gains @TotalShield@ Shield. Rakan's Attacks and Abilities against enemy champions reduce this Cooldown by @HitCooldown@ second.

Lover's Leap - Xayah and Rakan can recall together.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Rakan flings a magical feather that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the feather hits a champion or epic jungle monster, Rakan restores @TotalHeal@ Health to himself and nearby allies after @HealDelay@ seconds or when he touches an allied champion.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Gleaming Quill</titleLeft><mainText>Rakan is about to heal himself and nearby allies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

The QuicknessRakan gains Move Speed and charms all enemies he touches.

'I will walk in. I will dance. They will party.'Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rakan gains <speed>@InitialCastSpeed@% Move Speed</speed> for @Duration@ seconds. Rakan deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Charms</status> enemies for @CharmDuration@ second(s) the first time he touches them. The first champion touched grants Rakan <speed>@TouchSpeed@% decaying Move Speed</speed>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rakan dashes, then spirals into the air, <status>Knocking Up</status> for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: Rakan has knocked this unit in the air.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rakan has knocked this unit in the air.
